import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

f1 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0001.png').convert('RGB'))

f8 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0008.png').convert('RGB'))

# Table color: red around 130-170, green 50-80, blue 20-40
# Let's inspect legs of table
table_mask = (f1[:, :, 0] > 100) & (f1[:, :, 0] < 160) & (f1[:, :, 1] > 40) & (f1[:, :, 1] < 80) & (f1[:, :, 2] < 40)

for y in range(y_t.max()-5, y_t.max()+1):

    print(f'F1 table leg y={y}: xs from {xs.min()} to {xs.max()} (count {len(xs)})')
